scope: Direct review of three original performed preparations and all18 pending query/source pairs assigned to these preparations. Applicability is assessed separately for every query. TierB is an inferred compatible analogue,not an experiment on the predicted substrates,not a physical-arrow proof,and not a new retrieval calibration.

preparation.locator: Example85 at331770-332351,explicitly using Example82 bromophenyl isoindolamine and5-methoxypyridin3ylboronic acid by Example78/Scheme14N. Complete coupling method at325611-326600 was directly inspected;not Example81's para-methoxyphenyl substrate.
preparation.source_conditions: Example85 reports16%yield,1H NMR andESI411(M+H). Explicit Example78 method:Pd(dppf)Cl2.CH2Cl2/Cs2CO3,DME/water/ethanol6:3:1,microwave130 C,argon,15min;cool,filter,concentrate,preparativeHPLC. Example78's own pyrimidinyl substrate,masses,catalyst loading and13.4%yield are not transferred. Example85 has no reported enantiomeric assignment;source establishes the net coupling,not microscopic electron arrows.
preparation.structural_reconciliation: Independent endocyclic-N-first isoindol3amine transcription retains iminoN/exocyclicNH2,fused6-F,quaternary1-pyridin4yl/3-substitutedphenyl,andthe new5-methoxypyridin3yl carbon-carbon bond. Both independently named source substrates/product reconcile exactly to the original candidate key;no query molecule is substituted for the source structure.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query has an isoxazole carbonyl chloride on its boronic-acid partner and an ethyl cyclopropanecarboxylate aryl bromide,rather than the source isoindolamine/pyridyl partners.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: The source's aqueous/ethanolic carbonate conditions do not establish retention of the query's acid chloride;hydrolysis/alcoholysis or competing acyl chemistry must be addressed before transfer.
query_reviews.review_limitations: This is a missing compatibility precedent,not proof that no alternative coupling conditions can work. No TierD.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query couples4-pyridylboronic acid to a bromo/chloro arene carrying an E-styryl-N-acetylpiperazine substituent;source has no styryl group or second aryl halide.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: A general biaryl coupling is plausible,but this source alone does not establish the requested aryl-halide chemoselectivity and retention of the remote E-alkene under the hot palladium conditions.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Retain unresolved;do not claim Heck coupling or alkene isomerization actually occurred.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Source bromophenyl-isoindolamine plus5-methoxy3-pyridylboronic acid is replaced by a benzenoid bromo-N-benzylbenzimidazole plus a3-alkoxyphenylboronic acid bearing secondary alcohol/tertiary tetrahydroisoquinoline.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Same aryl-Br/arylboronic-acid Suzuki carbon-carbon construction and preserved full local reacting environment. Carbonate/aqueous alcoholic conditions do not demand cleavage of ether,N-benzyl or secondary alcohol;the source reaction already tolerates metal-binding pyridyl and unprotected amino/imine functionality. The query tertiary amine/alcohol can alter catalyst speciation and yield,but presents no identified obligatory destructive reaction under this condition class. This is a chemical compatibility inference,not measured query conversion.
query_reviews.review_limitations: No stereocenter is created or inverted at the coupling site;query alcohol stereochemistry is unspecified. Specific rate,yield,side-products and auxiliary-mixture match are unknown.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query couples a lactam-bearing arylboronic acid to para-bromophenyl sulfonamide whose N is explicitly NH2+;it also carries a methyl ester and amino-acid-derived side chain.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: The basic source conditions do not establish the query's persistent protonated sulfonamide formulation,charge balance or counterion inventory. A similar neutral-parent coupling is not a checked match to this ionic query.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Charge/role uncertainty is retained,not silently neutralized or called chemical impossibility.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query reverses which biaryl partner bears Br/B(OH)2 relative to query6bee7c:the boronic acid is N-benzylbenzimidazolyl and the bromide is3-alkoxyphenyl bearing secondary alcohol/tertiary tetrahydroisoquinoline. The performed source uses a pyridylboronic acid and an isoindolamine-substituted aryl bromide.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: This is separately reviewed as a different complete precursor set. Both partners retain the standard aryl-Br/arylboronic-acid handles and compatible local aromatic carbon environment. No acid-labile group is required to survive acidic deprotection;ether,N-benzyl,secondary alcohol and neutral tertiary amine are compatible spectators under the source's weakly basic aqueous/alcoholic coupling class. Nitrogen coordination or heteroaryl protodeboronation can affect efficiency but no mandatory conflicting functional reaction is identified. Source pyridyl/amino/imine tolerance supports this inference,not exact query success.
query_reviews.review_limitations: No stereogenic coupling center;remote alcohol unspecified. Same final biaryl as6bee7c does not make the two reactions or their experimental validation identical.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query swaps the aryl-Br/boronic-acid handles relative to7a428c but again retains an explicitly protonated NH2+ sulfonamide and ester/lactam scaffold.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: The source's basic medium does not establish this exact ionic substrate/product formulation. Reversing coupling handles does not resolve the unverified protonation/counterion context.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Neutral parent chemistry may be feasible;no neutralization is used to award support to the frozen charged query.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query includes a free primary amine and a primary alkyl bromide on the same chain,plus an aryl bromide and an N-protected pyrazolylboronic acid.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: The source does not address competition from intra/intermolecular amine alkylation or discrimination between aryl and alkyl bromides under heated basic conditions. A generic Suzuki precedent is insufficient for this multifunctional query.
query_reviews.review_limitations: No side reaction is asserted as observed;the concern limits analogue transfer only.

preparation.locator: Example55 at412991-413790,explicitly referencing the complete Example1 at361783-363190 with substituted coupling substrates. Not subsequent Example56's different propylamine or a claim-only compound list.
preparation.source_conditions: Example55 couples4-bromo1H-pyrazole3-carbonitrile and the named arylBpin/piperidine substrate by Example1:bis(tri-tert-butylphosphine)Pd(0),K2CO3,toluene/ethanol/water,nitrogen,sealed microwave135 C15min50W,aqueous/EtOAc workup andsilica chromatography. Source55 reportsLCMS363(M+H),1H NMR;individual yield/mass not stated. Example1's14mg9%yield,substrate amounts and1mol%loading are not transferred as55-specific measurements. ArylCl,freepyrazoleNH,piperidineN andnitrile remain in the named product.
preparation.structural_reconciliation: Independent pyrazole-NH-first traversal placesCN atC3,Br/newaryl atC4,NH atN1. The arylBpin is para to quaternary piperidineC4;that carbon also bears para-chlorophenyl,piperidineN remainsNH. Named source substrates/product reconcile exactly to the original candidate key,including its unprotected N-H groups.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query is a benzenoid bromo/fluoro N-substituted indole carrying piperidinyl oxadiazole,with para-methylsulfonylphenylBpin;source uses bromopyrazole nitrile and a diarylpiperidine arylBpin.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Both use an aryl/heteroarylC-Br and arylBpin to construct a biaryl C-C bond with the same admissible local carbon environment. Sulfone,arylF,N-substituted indole,tertiary piperidine and the oxadiazole have no obligatory cleavage under weak carbonate/aqueous alcoholic Suzuki conditions. Source55 demonstrates unprotected basic nitrogen/nitrile tolerance;the query's remote heteroatoms can affect coordination and yield,which are not predicted by the precedent.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Different heterocycle/scaffold and boronate electronics remain explicit;no exact substrate conversion,yield or every-arrow mechanism claim. No new stereogenic bond is formed.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query couples bromo/chloro1H-indole3-carbaldehyde to an arylBpin bearing N-Boc-pyrrolidine;source is bromopyrazole nitrile plus diarylpiperidine arylBpin.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Source55 provides a performed unprotectedN-H heteroaryl bromide/arylBpin coupling while retaining an aryl chloride. QueryBoc carbamate andaldehyde are compatible spectator classes under weak carbonate,short microwave Suzuki conditions;freeindoleNH is analogous to the source's unprotected heteroarylNH. Preferential use of Br over nonactivated arylCl is consistent with the source transformation. Query-specific reduction,side-products orselectivity are not experimentally measured here.
query_reviews.review_limitations: No claim of the same ring activation or guaranteed aldehyde/Boc survival;these are chemical compatibility judgements,not direct observations of the query. Remote stereochemistry unspecified.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query has N-sulfonyl azaindoleBr and a chloropyridylBpin bearing an aminocyclohexylBoc substituent;source uses a simpler arylBpin without an activated heteroaryl chloride.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: The electron-richPd/PtBu3 condition class can engage activated heteroaryl chlorides;the source's remote nonactivated chlorophenyl retention alone does not resolve this query's competing chloropyridyl site or heteroaryl-boronate stability.
query_reviews.review_limitations: RetainC pending a more closely matched chemoselective precedent,not a documented contradiction.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Same bromo/chloro1H-indole3-carbaldehyde electrophile as245e753a,but its arylBpin bears a quaternary hydroxymethylcyclobutyl substituent rather than source diarylpiperidine.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Individually reviewed Suzuki pairing,not inherited from245e753a. The source demonstrates unprotected heteroarylNH andarylCl retention. The query primary alcohol andaldehyde can remain under the weakly basic aqueous/alcoholic Pd coupling class,and cyclobutane is not a leaving group or ring-opening requirement of this transformation. Substrate-dependent selectivity or carbonyl side chemistry remains unknown,not asserted absent.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Compatible analogue only;not a reported reaction of this exact indole/boronate pair. No specified stereocenter is changed.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query couples a hydroxymethylpyridyl bromide bearing a fused diazinone to a pyridonylBpin/aminopyridyl/oxetanyl piperazine partner.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Multiple heteroaromatic nitrogen andcarbonyl sites,heteroarylboronate speciation andfreeCH2OH differ substantially from this source. A similar local Suzuki edit alone does not establish compatibility of this specific pairing under the source conditions.
query_reviews.review_limitations: This is the handle-swapped route to the same product as another reviewed complex query;neither product identity nor local edit certifies source transfer.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query uses free para-phenolic arylBpin and an ortho-amino/tertiarypiperidinol-substituted aryl bromide with isoxazole/pyrazine side chain.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Freephenol andseveral nitrogen donors introduce untested boronate/phenoxide/catalyst speciation and potential C-O versus C-C competition under an electron-rich phosphine catalyst. This source's nitrile/pyrazole/piperidine tolerance alone is insufficient to resolve the full query pairing.
query_reviews.review_limitations: The query may be synthetically feasible;retain unresolved rather than declaring a side reaction occurred.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query couples phenylBpin to5-bromo2-oxo1H-pyrimidine bearing an exocyclic chiral aminoaryl sulfonamide;source couples arylBpin to unprotected bromopyrazole nitrile.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Preserved heteroarylC-Br/arylBpin C-C construction and compatible full local reacting-carbon environment. Source55 tolerates freeheteroarylNH andbasic amine. The query pyrimidinone/lactam,tertiary sulfonamide andbenzylic amino stereocenter have no obligatory cleavage or enolization under weak carbonate coupling conditions;plain phenylBpin introduces no additional reactive leaving group. Ring electronics andnitrogen coordination may alter efficiency,which remains unknown.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Existing remote configured amino carbon is retained;coupling is atsp2 carbon anddoes not create a stereocenter. This is not an experimental epimerization or yield measurement.

preparation.locator: Example1 at40812-41903;Example2 adds15-crown5 andis a separate63%yield variant. Original source names4-chloro-N-methylphthalimide;its conventional name corresponds to5-chloro2-methylisoindole1,3dione,not the other chloro constitutional isomer.
preparation.source_conditions: Example1:anhydrous sodiumphenoxide0.440g(3.80mmol) and4-chloroN-methylphthalimide1.50g,250 C4h,N2autoclave,solvent-free molten substrate;45.6%analytical yieldbasedonphenoxide byGC/LC/o-terphenylstandard andretention-timecomparison withauthenticproduct. Separate recovery/distillation294-295 C720torr/toluene extraction gives substantiallysameyield,not a specified isolated mass. Sourceprints1.50g(76.7mmol),inconsistent withMW195.60(~7.67mmol);do not silently repair the reported stoichiometry. NoPd/Cucatalyst inExample1. Example2's15-crown5/63% is not assigned toExample1.
preparation.structural_reconciliation: Independent carbonyl-firstN-methyl imide traversal retains the chlorine/phenoxy position consistent with original candidate33e3487b;Na+andphenoxide charge remain explicit. PubChemCID246078 confirms the conventional4-chloroN-methylphthalimide name maps to5-chloro2-methylisoindole1,3dione;that nomenclature reference is not a new reaction precedent. The originalperformedsourceis an activated aromatic-imide etherification,not generic chlorobenzene activation.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query replaces activated chlorophthalimide with chlorobenzene andhas a complex phenoxide carrying a protonated ester/benzylic fluoride formulation.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Chlorobenzene lacks the source imide's electron-withdrawing activation;the source's catalyst-free molten reaction cannot establish this substitution. Ionic ester formulation and250 C stability are additional unknowns.
query_reviews.review_limitations: No statement that a separately catalysed aryl ether synthesis is impossible;the performed source is not transferable support.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query uses a5-chloro2-sulfonamido pyridine with explicitly protonated sulfonamide NH2+,not the source chlorophthalimide;phenoxide is a separate anion.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Ring nitrogen position andprotonated substituent do not reproduce the imide's activation,charge balance or source's thermal medium. A radius1 C-Cl/O edit alone does not justify an SNAr-transfer claim.
query_reviews.review_limitations: RetainC;do not infer an experimental failed reaction or silently neutralize the query.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query electrophile is an alkyl-substituted chloroanisole andnucleophile a hindered dimethylnitro phenoxide with a nonstandard explicit nitro protonation/charge representation.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: Electron-rich chloroanisole does not carry the source's activating imide carbonyl system;neither harsh catalyst-free thermal transfer nor the query ionic formulation is established by this experiment.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Other catalytic etherification conditions are outside this source review;C is not a documented contradiction.

query_reviews.substrate_differences: Query uses meta-chloroalkoxybenzene andan elaborate phenoxide bearing tertiarybenzylamine/nitro functionality;no activating phthalimide is present.
query_reviews.functional_group_compatibility: The source's activated imide chlorosubstitution does not establish activation of this alkoxy chlorobenzene or survival of allqueryfunctional groups in a250 C solvent-free melt.
query_reviews.review_limitations: Do not classify the generated aryl ether as impossible merely because this particular structural candidate is inadequate.
